articles.summary: There isn’t much better than a good old-fashioned get together. And let's be real: hosting a killer get-together doesn't mean wrecking the environment. At Veris Residential, we believe every celebration can be eco-friendly without killing the mood.
articles.title: How to Host an Eco-Friendly Gathering in Your Apartment

articles.summary: At Veris Residential, sustainability isn't just a buzzword—it's a way of life. Imagine a day where every choice you make contributes to a healthier planet, without feeling like you're sacrificing comfort or convenience. Curious about what that looks like? Let's dive into a green day in the life of a Veris resident.
articles.title: A Day in the Life: Living Sustainably at Veris Residential
